name: Afraid of Birds
desc: Disadvantage on attacks vs flying foes, but +2 Insight.
prompt: Describe the goose incident of your childhood.

name: Ancient Grudge
desc: +2 damage vs orcs and goblins (they know what they did).
prompt: Recount the 300-year-old insult your family still won't forgive.

name: Starwatcher
desc: +2 Perception and +2 Arcana; distracted at the worst times (-1 initiative).
prompt: Name a constellation and tell its sad story.

name: Insufferable Snob
desc: -2 Persuasion, +2 Intimidation. Mortals are so... short-lived.
prompt: Critique the local cuisine at length.

name: Leaf-Whisperer
desc: +3 Nature; +1 to hit vs beasts (they hesitate).
prompt: What did the oldest tree you know tell you?

name: Light Sleeper
desc: Never surprised: +3 initiative.
prompt: Describe the sound that woke you last night.

name: Beard Pride
desc: +2 Intimidation; frightened lasts a turn less (minimum 1).
prompt: Name your beard and describe its finest braid.

name: Compulsive Collector
desc: Finds better loot (+10% rarity luck) but insists on picking up every rock.
prompt: Show the party your favorite rock. What makes it special?

name: Ale-Powered
desc: +3 max HP; -1 Stealth (you clink).
prompt: What's the finest ale you ever drank, and where?

name: Grudgebearer
desc: +1 to hit vs anything that has hurt you this fight... and giants, always.
prompt: Read an entry from your Book of Grudges.

name: Stone Sense
desc: +2 Perception and +1 AC (you know where to stand).
prompt: Explain, passionately, why this wall is load-bearing.

name: Hates Water
desc: -2 Athletics, but resistant to cold.
prompt: Describe your one terrible boat trip.

name: Overachiever
desc: +1 to every skill, but -1 to WIS saves (you overthink).
prompt: List three things you're the best at.

name: Lucky Coin
desc: Crit range widened by 1 on everything. Flip it before big decisions.
prompt: Who gave you the coin, and what did they say?

name: Rhymes When Nervous
desc: +2 Performance, -1 Deception. Speak only in rhymes when hurt below half HP.
prompt: Compose a two-line rhyme about your current predicament.

name: Merchant's Blood
desc: Start with 40 extra gold; +2 Persuasion when money is involved.
prompt: Pitch the party a product you just invented.

name: Former Farmhand
desc: +2 Athletics and +2 Nature. Knows a suspicious amount about turnips.
prompt: Describe the prize-winning vegetable you grew.

name: Probably the Chosen One
desc: +1 to all saves. A prophecy may or may not be about you.
prompt: Recite the part of the prophecy you're sure is about you.

name: Gentle Giant
desc: +3 Persuasion, +2 healing received. Loves small animals.
prompt: Introduce the party to the animal you adopted this morning.

name: Secret Poet
desc: +2 Performance and +1 CHA saves. Writes verses about battles.
prompt: Recite a haiku about the last thing you hit.

name: Battle Scars
desc: +4 max HP. Every scar has a story, all of them exaggerated.
prompt: Tell the (heavily embellished) story of your biggest scar.

name: Indoor Voice? Never
desc: Shout minigames are easier (+15%), Stealth -2.
prompt: Announce your arrival to the room. Loudly.

name: Tusk Polisher
desc: +2 Intimidation and +1 initiative. Vain about dental care.
prompt: Explain your morning tusk routine.

name: Iron Gut
desc: Immune to poisoned. Will eat anything once.
prompt: What's the strangest thing you've eaten, and was it good?

name: Draconic Hoarder
desc: +15% loot luck; -1 Persuasion when asked to share.
prompt: What's the centerpiece of your hoard?

name: Smoke Rings
desc: Blow minigames +15%; +1 Performance.
prompt: Show off your smoke-ring trick (and narrate it).

name: Honor-Bound
desc: +1 AC, -2 Deception. Can't tell a convincing lie.
prompt: Swear an oath to the party right now.

name: Dragon Scholar
desc: +2 to hit and +2 damage vs dragons; +1 Arcana.
prompt: Name the great dragon you claim as an ancestor.

name: Cold-Blooded
desc: -1 initiative in the morning grogginess, but +2 CON saves.
prompt: Describe your ideal sunbathing rock.

name: Expressive Tail
desc: +2 Insight; -2 Deception (your tail gives you away).
prompt: What does your tail do when you're happy?

name: Scroll Hoarder
desc: +2 max Spell Points; you smell like old paper.
prompt: What's the most useless scroll you own?

name: Failed Familiar
desc: Your 'familiar' is a confused rock. +1 Insight, +1 Arcana.
prompt: Introduce your familiar and its many accomplishments.

name: Pyromaniac
desc: +2 damage on fire spells... applied to everything: +1 damage on all hits.
prompt: What's the first thing you ever set on fire?

name: Calligrapher
desc: Rune drawing is easier (+15%).
prompt: Sign your name with a flourish. Describe the flourish.

name: Kleptomaniac
desc: +10% loot luck. Sometimes steals from the party (narratively).
prompt: Return something you 'borrowed' from another player.

name: Dramatic Exits
desc: +2 Acrobatics, +1 AC.
prompt: Describe how you leave a room. Every room.

name: Whisperer
desc: Quiet minigames are easier (+15%), +1 Stealth.
prompt: Whisper your greatest secret to the person on your left.

name: Wanted Poster
desc: +2 Deception, -1 Persuasion. Your face is on posters (badly drawn).
prompt: What crime is on the poster, and did you do it?

name: Oath Stickler
desc: +2 WIS saves; you correct everyone's manners.
prompt: Recite the most oddly specific line of your oath.

name: Polished to a Mirror
desc: +1 AC, -2 Stealth (you gleam).
prompt: Describe your armor-polishing ritual.

name: Undead Hunter
desc: +2 to hit vs undead.
prompt: Who did the undead take from you?

name: Soft Heart
desc: +2 to all healing you receive and +1 Persuasion.
prompt: Who is the person you'd do anything for?

name: Crisis of Faith
desc: +2 Insight; your god occasionally doesn't answer (-1 Religion).
prompt: What question would you ask your god face to face?

name: Preachy
desc: +2 Persuasion vs believers, +1 Intimidation. Sermons are long.
prompt: Deliver a 10-second sermon to the party.

name: Field Medic
desc: Your heals restore +2 HP.
prompt: Describe the worst wound you've ever stitched.

name: Relic Keeper
desc: +2 Religion, +1 AC vs undead (they hate the bone).
prompt: Show us the holy relic. Whose bone is it?

name: One-Hit Wonder
desc: +2 Performance; everybody knows your one song.
prompt: Hum the chorus of your one famous song.

name: Heckler
desc: Shout minigames +15%; +1 Intimidation.
prompt: Heckle the nearest monster (or player).

name: Perfect Pitch
desc: Hum and rhythm minigames +10%.
prompt: Sing the note of the room you're in.

name: Incurable Gossip
desc: +2 Insight and +2 Deception; everyone tells you things.
prompt: Share some (made-up) gossip about another player's character.

name: Short Fuse
desc: +2 initiative; -1 Persuasion.
prompt: Name the tiny thing that makes you furious.

name: Big Softie
desc: +2 Insight, +2 healing received. Cries at weddings.
prompt: What made you cry last?

name: Speaks in Grunts
desc: +2 Intimidation, -2 Persuasion. Surprisingly eloquent grunts.
prompt: Explain the plan. Using only grunts.

name: Wild Swinger
desc: Swing minigames +15%.
prompt: Demonstrate your signature swing (carefully).

name: Drill Sergeant
desc: +2 Intimidation; +1 initiative. Barks orders.
prompt: Give the party a motivational drill command.

name: Names Their Weapons
desc: +1 to hit. Your sword has a name and feelings.
prompt: Introduce your weapon by name and tell us its feelings.

name: Grizzled Veteran
desc: +3 max HP, +1 Insight. 'I've seen worse.'
prompt: Tell us about the time you saw worse.

name: Shield Enthusiast
desc: +1 AC; collects shields.
prompt: What's painted on your shield, and why?

name: Always Hungry
desc: +2 healing from potions and rests... and food. Mostly food.
prompt: What snack did you bring on this adventure?

name: Arachnophobe
desc: -2 to hit vs spiders, +2 Perception (you're always looking).
prompt: Act out finding a spider in your boot.

name: Born Lucky
desc: Crit on 19-20 with everything; trip over flat ground.
prompt: Describe the most unlikely thing that ever went right for you.

name: Tough as Boots
desc: +3 max HP.
prompt: What's the hardest thing you ever survived?
